title: Closeout summary: Unknown-flag errors suggest nearest registered flag
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented unknown-flag suggestions in validateCommandFlags. Unknown registered-command flags now include a message hint and details.didYouMean when a nearest allowed flag is available; --parent is treated as a known alias for --container, and --prio suggests --priority. Extended the CLI unknown-flag test to assert --parent on work list suggests --container and --prio suggests --priority. Verification passed: pnpm check; pnpm vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts -t 'rejects unknown flags'; pnpm vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts; pnpm bwrk docs check --json; git diff --check. Commit checkpoint was attempted earlier in this sandbox and failed because .git writes are denied, so closeout records a git_unavailable dirty-path note.

Close reason: Unknown-flag didYouMean recovery implemented and verified; git checkpoint blocked by sandboxed .git write permissions.
